Nana's Scones

Serves 8. A family favourite that never lasts the afternoon.

Ingredients

  • 2 cups self-raising flour
  • 1/2 cup cream
  • 1 cup lemonade
  • pinch of salt

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 425°F and line a tray.
  2. Mix everything into a soft dough; do not overwork it.
  3. Cut out rounds and bake for 12 minutes.
